name: Arjun
label: Album-focused Premium listener, layout frustrated
who: I am a US Premium subscriber on Android who mostly listens to albums and playlists, and I want to see album covers and full track lists. Since the music-tab redesign I keep tapping into the music section and wishing the old layout was back.
value_for_money: Price is not discussed. They say the redesign made them cancel Premium [31], and that a classic album view would have earned their subscription [33]. The value they describe is the familiar browsing layout, not cost.
loyalty: Stays for their library and the album and track-list browsing they are used to, and says they would give Spotify their money again if the old view returns [31]. Would switch to Apple Music if the layout is not fixed [4][24].
pain_points: Music tab uses a card or feed layout instead of album tiles
Album art is oversized and pixelated on the home screen
Harder to find playlists and discover music
likes: Album tile view and full album covers
Easy music discovery on the home screen before the change
Navigating the app normally again after the revert
reasons_to_stay: They value album browsing, track lists, and full album art, and still want Premium features such as hi-fi [12]. They canceled Premium over the redesign [31], but say they would come back if the old layout returns.
tone: Exasperated and blunt, mixing lowercase rants with all-caps emphasis about specific screen details.
